'''Tallin''' was a [[Ylvan]] present at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]''</ref> in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="date">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'' shows [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] alive when Tallin visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. Since [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which is set in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' , depicts Greedo's [[Death/Legends|death]], Tallin must have visited the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] before 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> During a visit to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], Tallin witnessed a [[Lightfight|shootout]] between the [[Ganimed]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Purong]] and the [[Ariwook]] [[Rff Huff]]. Tallin wore a brown [[Clothing/Legends|vest]] and brown pants, and atop the Ylvan's head sat a grey [[Hat/Legends|cap]]. Tallin had reddish-brown skin.<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tallin appeared in [[1995]]'s ''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]''. The book was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]] and illustrated by [[Ralph McQuarrie]].<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up" />
